def factor_tail_asymmetric_vol_ewm(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    logret = np.log(df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].shift(1))
    downside_sq = np.where(logret < 0, logret**2, 0.0)
    upside_sq = np.where(logret > 0, logret**2, 0.0)
    downs = pd.Series(downside_sq, index=df_copy.index).ewm(span=60, min_periods=20).mean()
    ups = pd.Series(upside_sq, index=df_copy.index).ewm(span=60, min_periods=20).mean()
    asym = (downs - ups) / (downs + ups).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return asym.rename("factor_tail_asymmetric_vol_ewm")
description: Preserves the parent mechanism of downside vs upside realized variance asymmetry as a tail-risk signal. Mutation replaces equal-weight 60-day rolling mean with 60-day exponentially weighted moving average (span=60) to reduce lag and react faster to recent volatility regime shifts while retaining long-term stability. The ratio remains bounded between -1 and 1 when denominator non-zero, focusing on residual downside pressure after industry/size neutralization.
